prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Create the FINAL playable pixel-art HOUSE INTERIOR from Image 1, an architectural layout guide. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY, do NOT copy its layout. Output exact 1536x1024. Image 1 is authoritative for house silhouette, all room positions and sizes, wall segments, open door gaps, bottom entrance, and every labeled furniture bounding box. Paint every block into its named furniture at exactly the same position/footprint; blue BED blocks are single beds unless identified double below. Green CHAIR is sofa/chair with readable seating. Orange KITCHEN is stove/sink counter. Brown DESK/TABLE/SHELF/ALBUM/CABINET become matching objects. Keep walkways and doorway gaps completely empty. DO NOT add large extra floor furniture, rooms, walls, doors, beds or people. Dark background outside cutaway footprint must remain dark and empty; do not enlarge a compact home to fill the canvas. Flat overhead three-quarter Stardew Valley inspired crisp 16-bit game pixel art, hard pixel clusters, limited shading, dark pixel edges, Nordic timber/plaster/stone interiors. No blur, painterly strokes, photorealism, perspective convergence or isometric diamond. Small decorations may be ON furniture or walls; flat rugs underfoot do not block paths. REMOVE ALL guide labels and flat color blocks, no writing, UI, watermark. Room walls must not hide doorway gaps. Do not introduce closed doors. Household artistic identity (use as aesthetic direction ONLY; the guide overrides all described left/right/upper locations): Vesper and Xander adult siblings in river BOATHOUSE. Weathered dark oak, slate and muted teal, rope/nautical carved detailing. Left Vesper bedroom deep plum quilt, tidy closed correspondence box, right Xander bedroom dark red quilt, strategy maps without writing pinned to wall. Existing living study table has small carved boat model and navigation chart, existing shelves hold rolled charts and blue jars. Kitchen dark blue cupboards and copper kettle, sand-color striped flat runner, navy armchair. River identity, no added boats on floor.. All BED blocks are SINGLE beds.  STRICT BED COUNT: TWO single beds. Never put any bed in a study or gallery.
